field.label: Subscription URL
field.help: HTTPS subscription URL. Leave empty to keep the currently stored URL; the panel only displays a masked form (scheme://host/***).

field.label: Automatic Update
field.help: Register a cron job that renews the subscription and recomposes the configuration automatically.

field.label: Update Interval
field.help: How often the automatic subscription update runs (6, 12 or 24 hours).
